commands.label: Import compiled extension and call corpus_greeting()

semantic_scope: SIP parses hello.sip, emits wrapper C, compiles and links a CPython extension; Python imports the actual extension and calls its native C function, asserting the returned Hello, World! string.
environment_capture: Only the relevant overrides supplied by the check runner are shown; PATH_prepend records the venv bin directory prepended to the inherited PATH. SIP runtime PYTHONPATH points to the directory containing the compiled extension.
